newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures seesaw sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures seesaw sharply lower.

text.p: May 20 - U.S. stock index futures seesawed sharply lower in busy nervous early trading. Brokers said dealers sold heavily near outset, continued erosion in dollar, T-bond futures weighed down stocks. June S&P 500s broke below supports near 830.60, halted above 828.10, 827.70 areas seen as next support. Dow 30 fell 50, NYSE set curb on index arb.
